heading: Core Movement Objectives
subheading: Our strategic priorities to ensure the Constitution remains a living, breathing safeguard for future generations of Indians.

items.title: Nationwide Constitutional Literacy
items.desc: Establish Samvidhan Pathshalas in all 780+ districts of India, ensuring every citizen reads and understands the Preamble, Fundamental Rights, and RTI.

items.title: Safeguard Judicial Independence
items.desc: Advocate for transparent judicial appointments, resist political interference in constitutional courts, and oppose extra-judicial executive demolitions.

items.title: Pro-Bono Legal Defense Network
items.desc: Mobilize 10,000 advocate members to provide immediate, free constitutional writ representation for citizens facing illegal arrest or censorship.

items.title: Youth Samvidhan Fellowships
items.desc: Train 5,000 young university scholars in constitutional research, public interest litigation drafting, and grassroots civic organizing.

items.title: Strengthen Federal Autonomy
items.desc: Empower state governments and local Gram Panchayats to defend their 73rd and 74th Amendment powers against over-centralized executive control.
